rule: Only hops with committed raw capture artifacts are promoted. A blocked capture run promotes nothing, writes no frames and claims no surface. Prose, source pointers and test summaries do not qualify (docs/trace/CAPTURE-REGISTRY.md rules 1-4).

blockers.message: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is absent and LIVE_ONE_PROMPT is unset in this seat's process environment, so the paid live streaming/replay specs cannot run and no raw S10/S27 capture can be produced. No paid call was made and no frame/hop was fabricated.
blockers.how_to_fix: Operator/e2e lane: set LIVE_ONE_PROMPT=1 and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in the process env (explicit approval + budget cap), set E2E_SERVER_BIN=<repo>\target\release\hiverouter.exe, run: cd e2e; playwright test specs/live-streaming.spec.ts specs/live-replay.spec.ts --project=chrome --reporter=json ; persist WS frames/DOM/PNG under docs/trace/live/captures/w11/ ; then the trace seat validates the raw artifacts and promotes only captured hops.
blockers.owner: e2e/QA lane + operator (key/budget); trace seat validates
blockers.required_operator_action: provide the key in process env + set LIVE_ONE_PROMPT=1
